science_question: Does the smooth spline interpolant of the CRN Monte-Carlo transfer table reproduce the colored-noise LIF stationary rate and its zero-frequency mean/variance gains at workpoints NOT on the grid, across interictal, depleted-middle and high-rate regimes, for E and I cell parameters?
primary_readout: relative rate error |phi_spline - phi_MC| / phi_MC at held-out workpoints; zero-frequency gain sign agreement for mean, AMPA-variance and GABA-variance channels; gain relative error
statistical_unit: independent noise path (replicate) of the held-out MC run; held-out runs use a DIFFERENT seed (not CRN with the table)
held_out_workpoints: the 8 v2-assayed (state, group) workpoints SN1/SN7/upper_D0228 (mean, variance_E, variance_I, thresholds 16.22 and 18)
24 random draws per population in the joint range x in [-2, 20], sigma_E in [0.1, 4], sigma_I in [0, 6] (log-uniform sigma), seed 7
8 draws per population in the extreme mean-driven range x in [20, 200]
tolerance_basis: native SNN variability: interictal group rates across the two native seeds differ by ~2-4 % (events_4_8s mean_rate 24.0 vs 24.5 Hz); the v1 native small-set assay showed local closure vs isolated-LIF disagreements of 2-3x, so the acceptance bar targets the closure's own consistency, not the diffusion assumption

tolerances.rate: relative error <= 3 % for MC rate >= 1 Hz, or absolute <= 0.05 Hz for MC rate < 1 Hz, after accounting for 3 SEM of the held-out MC
tolerances.gain_sign: sign of each channel gain must match when |gain| > 3 SEM
tolerances.gain_magnitude: relative error <= 15 % when |gain| > 10 SEM (derivative of an interpolant is less precise than its value)
tolerances.smoothness: no sign change of d(phi)/d(mu) anywhere on the grid; second differences of log-rate along x bounded by the MC-implied curvature (reported, not gated)

failure_action: if any tolerance fails at more than 2 held-out points per population: refine grid / replicates in that region and re-validate with a new seed; do not widen the tolerance
not_covered: this validates the interpolant against the same Gaussian-diffusion LIF; the diffusion assumption itself is tested in stage A4 against the native network
